text: Use the delivery results and board state a caller passed in, where this run follows one that already brought the board current. A request made directly by the user supplies none, so the checkpoint is absent.
Apply the status [Board Status](#board-status) gives that state and Status:
Prepare the directory in [Record Selection](#record-selection "○") using the matching branch.
Execute only the branch matching [Confirmed Placement](#confirmed-placement "○"):
Apply [Read Board State](../artifacts/board.md#read-board-state "ƒ") for the selected board immediately before acquiring the unit's hold.
Use the epic body provided by Record Epic Delivery.
For a task or a hot-fix, retain the task delivery result its delivering pull request established.
Apply [Close Tracker Issue](../artifacts/issue.md#close-tracker-issue "ƒ") with the issue identity and the successful normal delivery result.
Use the review number in the supplied delivery findings.
